title: Mandelbrot
description: Pinch to fall into the Mandelbrot set, and keep falling — 68 levels of zoom, every one of them revealing structure that was not there before. A double-double reference orbit and GPU perturbation carry the picture millions of times past the point where ordinary 64-bit maths dissolves into blocks. Press and hold anywhere and that point sings: its orbit becomes the waveform, so the bulbs ring like bells and the chaotic boundary comes out gritty. Slide your finger to play it.
